name: warnings
title: What a warning looks like in the original (owner's playtest 2026-10-24; crates/fnv-game/src/aggro.rs 'The look', docs/spec-notes/idles.md section 14.3, docs/design/combat-ai.md section 13.1). young_gecko: the player walks up to VERGSGecko6REF 0x00157B3C (a Young Gecko: Unaggressive, aggro radius 500, DefaultSandboxEditorLocation512) from 900 units to 300 and stays: does it stop, face the player, read GetIsAlerted 1, play idles (IsIdlePlaying), count warnings (GetTrespassWarningLevel), then attack, and when? The samples outside 500 are the control. gomorrah_cashroom / gomorrah_bouncer: Guard packages' own warnings. vGomorrahGuardPackage (Guard, near editor location radius 0, target the linked reference within 25, warn/attack allowed): the cash-room guard 0x00127950 guards door 0x0010D6B9 (140 units from him), bouncer vGOMBouncerRef01 0x0011945E guards door 0x0010DAFA (167 units). The player walks to the door and stands there: where does warning begin (distance to the door and to the guard at the first warning level change), does the guard draw (weapon out), stop, face, attack after iGuardWarnings? Run each session alone (--only): a fight in Gomorrah spoils the other Gomorrah session. God mode only (no tdetect: it would hide the player from the very detection being observed).
